A 60-year-old man was killed in a road accident after being struck by a heavy commercial truck in Palanaganatham here on Sunday.
According to police, the victim, identified as Meenakshisundaram, was crossing Tirupparankundram Road at Palanganatham when the traffic signal was red. A heavy carrier truck struck and ran over him, causing fatal injuries on the spot.
